name: Glass Desktop
author: GlassDesktop contributors
description: Truly see-through Steam: your real desktop and other windows show behind Library, Store, Community, Settings and menus. Text stays sharp. Profiles keep their own background. Needs tools/SteamGlass.exe (starts Steam for you).

Mode.description: Normal and Opaque: solid Steam. Clear: background and bars see-through, cards behind text. Frosted: near-solid cards. Ghost: only text and art. Readable: solid cards and bars. Tinted: whole window fades evenly. OLED Black: pure black. Custom: use the sliders below. (Blur/Acrylic are not possible: Steam's browser paints every pixel solid.)

Transparency %.description: How see-through all of Steam is (text, art, panels). 0 = solid. Works in every mode except Normal, Opaque and OLED Black. Applies live.

Glass tint strength %.description: How dark the glass behind text is, in every mode. Raise it on bright wallpapers so text never washes out. Independent of Transparency %. 100 = the mode's default, 200 = solid.

Preset.description: Colour of the glass. Default: neutral smoke. Midnight: deep blue-black. Light glass: lighter slate. High contrast: black cards, bright edges.

Toggle hotkey.description: Global hotkey that turns transparency off and on (for screenshots and screen sharing). Off = solid dark background. Applies live.

Panel opacity %.description: Custom mode: darkness of the cards behind text. 0 = invisible, 100 = solid.

Bar opacity %.description: Custom mode: sidebar, title bar, bottom bar, Store/Community header. 0 = clear.

Text halo %.description: Custom mode: dark rim around text. 0 = off.

Corner radius.description: Roundness of cards and dialogs, in px.

Font.description: Font for the whole Steam UI, Store and Community. All ship with Windows (nothing is downloaded).

Accent glow.description: Glow around hovered buttons and focused inputs.

Window border.description: Thin accent outline around every Steam window.

Dim game art.description: Darken game images slightly so text over them reads better.

Reduce motion.description: Turn off animations and transitions (lighter on CPU/GPU).
